title: Seller Adjustment Kind
description: Kind of bounded change a buyer pre-authorizes the seller to apply to a live media buy without a new offer. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_adjustment_allowances).

enumDescriptions.budget_release: The seller may reduce a purchase's committed budget when it forecasts under-delivery, instead of under-delivering. Reduce only: never an increase and never a price change. The released budget is no longer billable and returns to the buyer.
enumDescriptions.schedule_shift: The seller may move an installment, spot, or airing within an agreed window, to an ordered pre-approved alternate, or both. The general form of broadcast line alternates.
